# Why was my Facebook or Instagram catalog upload rejected?

> Free Meta catalog feed CSV checker for Commerce Manager: finds semicolon or UTF-16 files, missing required columns, duplicate ids, prices without a currency, bad sale prices, wrong availability values, empty or http links, WebP images, invalid barcodes and Excel damage, with line numbers and safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
